description: This file declares the interface for the AMR speech decoder, including the Decoder_amrState structure, initialization, reset, and decoding functions, as well as related constants and external dependencies.

methods.name: Decoder_amr_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the state memory for the AMR decoder.

methods.name: Decoder_amr_reset
methods.description: Resets the state memory of the AMR decoder to default values.

methods.name: Decoder_amr
methods.description: Performs speech decoding given the current state, mode, parameters, frame type, and outputs synthesized speech and filter coefficients.
